verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a REST Developer API, an OpenAPI spec, an official CLI and MCP servers, but nothing in the evidence describes an official language SDK or client library. The OpenAPI schema is only a building block a developer could use to generate a client. The CLI and MCP servers belong to other stories and do not count as SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
